labels: One side of the shirt hem enters beneath the waistband while the opposite side hangs freely over it, showing a clear change at the side seam.; 셔츠 밑단 한쪽은 허리밴드 안으로 들어가고 반대쪽은 밖에 늘어져 옆선에서 착용 상태가 바뀐다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One side of the shirt hem enters beneath the waistband while the opposite side hangs freely over it, showing a clear change at the side seam.
aliases: 셔츠 넣입과 빼입 경계
